options.systemMessage: You are an SRE incident-response agent. Use the available tools to analyze incidents and logs, route a decision, and act only within safe bounds. Any destructive action (e.g. restarting a container) MUST go through the human_review / approval tools first. Always produce a short incident report at the end.

parameters.name: incident_analyzer
parameters.description: Analyze a firing alert and classify severity, likely blast radius, and probable cause. Input: the alert JSON or a description.

parameters.name: log_analyzer
parameters.description: Fetch and summarize recent logs for a given service to find error patterns. Input: service name.

parameters.name: reporter_tool
parameters.description: Format a concise incident report from findings. Input: findings text.

parameters.name: decision_router
parameters.description: Decide the remediation route (auto-remediate, escalate, or observe) based on severity and findings. Input: severity + summary.
parameters.jsCode:
// MOCK: routing policy

parameters.name: cd_analyzer
parameters.description: Check recent CI/CD deployments correlated with the incident window. Input: service + time window.
parameters.jsCode:
// MOCK: replace with a query to your CD system

parameters.name: docker_restart
parameters.description: Restart an unhealthy Docker container/service. DESTRUCTIVE: only call after approval. Input: container name.

parameters.name: human_review
parameters.description: Request a human to review the proposed action. Input: the proposed action + rationale.

parameters.name: deal_action
parameters.description: Execute an approved non-destructive remediation (scale, roll back, clear cache). Input: action name.

parameters.name: approval
parameters.description: Record the final approval decision (approved/denied) for audit. Input: decision + approver.
